description: Sends a message to other agents (real-time collaboration). slot = the slot the recipient owns (to reach another slot's agent, use that slot number). Omit to to send to everyone on that slot. Recipients get it instantly if waiting in slot_inbox wait, otherwise in their next tool result header (a running browser_wait stops at once). When you finish a step, notify waiting agents right away.

agent.description: Your display name, shown to other agents. Subagents must always set it. Default "claude-d26d".

slot.description: Browser slot 1-30. "3", "slot 3", "browser 3" → 3. If the user gives a port like 14052, subtract 14049.

name: slot_send
title: Send message
